description: Reject (decline) an order; order managers only. A non-empty reason is required; the requester is notified with it. Releases any reserved stock. Fails on already-closed orders. Irreversible: a closed order cannot be reopened.

reason.description: Required non-empty reason shown to the requester in their notification

name: reject_order

closedAtIso.description: The same moment as an ISO-8601 UTC timestamp — read THIS one; the server does no timezone conversion

webUrl.description: Link to this order in the web app, for a person to open; `orderId` is the handle for tool calls. Absent when the deployment has no public address

title: Reject order
